entries.7841ef527b9d4c5e: This is the principal business of the company's group. Sanyodo Shoten Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, operates stores that sell and rent books, trading cards and other items, and Sanyodo Purogure Co., Ltd. operates a buffet business. As of March 31, 2026, there were 67 stores and 2 schools, and 58 stores were operated in the Tokai and Hokuriku regions. The company is a holding company, and the group consists of the company, two consolidated subsidiaries and one other affiliate.
